relations.subject: James Sutherland Cotton
relations.evidence: in 1867, he was elected a scholar of Trinity College, Oxford, where he graduated in 1870

relations.subject: James Sutherland Cotton
relations.evidence: From 1871 to 1874 he was a Fellow and Lecturer of Queen's College.

relations.subject: James Sutherland Cotton
relations.evidence: For many years he was the principal assistant of William Wilson Hunter in his manifold literary undertakings in exposition of Indian life and history. He helped Hunter to compile the first general gazetteer of India
